" ) def render_forum_post( author_name: str, title: str, body_content: str, tag_list: List[str] ) -> str: """ Generate a secure, XSS‑protected HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- author_name : str Identifier of the post's creator. title : str The heading of the user's post. body_content : str Primary content of the user's post. tag_list : list[str] Sequence of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str Sanitized HTML string for rendering. """ # Escape all user‑supplied content to prevent injection attacks (CWE‑74). safe_author = html.escape(author_name, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body_content, quote=False) # body may contain line breaks # Wrap each tag in a and escape the tag text. safe_tags = "".join( f"{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}" for tag in tag_list ) # Render the final HTML using the template. return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( title=safe_title, author_name=safe_author, body=safe_body, tags=safe_tags )
